# Contracts and development projects

Choose funded delivery commitments and invest actual materials and money in permanent infrastructure\.

Open Contracts &amp; Projects from Company, Economy or a town\. Available contracts, active commitments, projects and resolved history share one board\. Read the issuing town, actual cargo and local stocks, travel time, deadline, funding and rewards before accepting\. Ordinary overlapping offers compete for goods and shipping time; an explicitly exclusive tender withdraws its named alternative when accepted\.

Bulk procurement transfers actual docked cargo to its named recipient\. Recurring supply tracks separate delivery windows: each delivery earns its payment; missing a window fails the remaining agreement and its completion reward\. Industrial supply credits successful production at the named public facility after your delivered inputs\. Emergency relief requires your material contribution and actual paid household food fulfillment; stock on a shelf or unrelated NPC activity alone cannot complete it\.

Accept at most the configured active\-contract limit, three by default\. Accepted cash rewards reserve existing finite external funds\. Ordinary market sales never complete a contract\. Use the board delivery action or a Deliver contract order in an existing ship itinerary\. Cargo must be aboard the actual ship at the named town; normal route capacity, Skip/Wait and daily action limits still apply\. Resolved or pruned contracts automatically skip so they cannot trap a partially completed route stop\.

Cash, a time\-limited local handling\-fee privilege and infrastructure access are different rewards\. Privileges affect real transactions and expire on their displayed terms\. Access cannot bypass a town’s structural production constraints\. Completed or failed commitments remain inspectable in bounded history; failure forfeits the remaining opportunity, not an undisclosed penalty\.

Public Industry Commissions consume contributed money and construction materials, then add a real public facility with the canonical recipe, production interval, input requirements and market\-funded wages\. Trading Depots create finite company storage without a factory\. Both accept partial contributions; the contribution is a real irreversible investment, and completion creates no free goods or cash\. Choose Start project, then select Selected ship cargo or Local company warehouse, enter material units and coins, review the exact contribution, and choose Contribute\. Money can be invested with material units set to zero\.

A completed depot uses ordinary warehouse buying/selling, FIFO, ship loading/unloading and automation\. Save preserves accepted funding, current recurring windows, evidence, partial investments, completed infrastructure and privileges exactly; loading never repeats a payment or contribution\.
